source.title: Freshwater fauna of Panay: preliminary survey on fish and shrimps
source.containerTitle: Seventeenth Report 2014: An Update and Thorough Revision of the Sixteenth Report 2013
source.author: Maren Gaulke; report edited by Eberhard Curio
source.publicationNote: Report covers the year 2014; front matter is dated January 2015.

scopeReview.geographicDescription: Short-term surveys in several north and northwest Panay river systems and nearby upland streams.
reportedSurveyAreas: A small rivulet on the slope of Mt. Madja-as
scopeReview.sourceReportedFishSummary: The report says approximately 40 freshwater fish species from 15 families were recorded, with some taxa not yet identified.
scopeReview.coverageLimit: The summary is island/region-level across surveys described as occurring during past years; it does not provide a retrievable species-by-river or specimen-by-site crosswalk in the reviewed section.
scopeReview.targetCatalogFit: Freshwater fish scope is relevant to the Philippines fish catalog. Freshwater shrimp discussion is outside the currently defined fish catalog and is excluded from species acquisition here.

rightsAndAccess.copyrightNotice: The report states: no part may be used without written permission from PanayCon Management or the PhilinCon Board of Directors.
rightsAndAccess.license: No open reuse license established; written permission required by the report notice.
rightsAndAccess.repositoryTreatment: Retain bibliographic facts, URL, and a concise internal scope assessment only. Do not reproduce the report's species list, prose, figures or photographs in the app or public repository data.

decision.use: Discovery lead and scope planning only
decision.nextAcquisitionAction: Seek a separately published, openly licensed species-by-waterbody dataset or obtain written permission and a specimen/site crosswalk before extracting species records. Do not count the approximately 40 regional summary taxa as site-specific occurrences.

limitations: Survey dates, sampling effort by site and exact per-river taxon membership are not established by the reviewed section.
A fish mentioned in regional descriptive prose is not automatically an occurrence in each named waterbody.
Historical survey statements cannot establish current presence, abundance, catchability, diet, safety or fishing permission.
The report's discovery scope does not establish a complete Panay, Western Visayas or national freshwater baseline.
